text: {"lessons":["Selling some Stock A after a strong gain felt satisfying, but I should base future trades on the outlook and portfolio balance, not just the pleasure of locking in gains.","A recent decline in account value is uncomfortable, especially given how much losses bother me, but I should avoid reacting to short-term moves alone.","I have rarely traded so far; I should continue to make deliberate, diversified decisions and avoid trading just for the sake of activity."]}
